newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Denway reorganisation may change control.
newsitem.headline: Denway reorganisation may change control.

text.p: Car maker Denway Investment Ltd said on Tuesday a proposed reorganisation plan may change the control of the company and might or might not trigger a general offer under Hong Kong listing rules.

Trading in the company's shares, suspended shortly after the stock market opened on Monday, would remain suspended pending a further announcement on the details of the proposal, Denway said in a statement published in newspapers on Tuesday.
Denway is involved in automobile manufacturing and trading primarily through its holding in Gunangzhou Peugeot, a joint venture with France's Peugeot SA.
The company said discussions in relation to reorganisation plans for the group had now come to an advanced stage with a proposal that may change the control of the company.
Denway shares last traded at HK$0.77 on Monday morning prior to the suspension.
